# JUL-999 retrospective: practice card for the saved stage picks

The practice brief identifies commit `8da32d3` on main as the change for JUL-999, squashed from pull request #999, touching `machine/merge/retro.mjs`. The supplied Shipping record has one determination, "PASS on 8da32d3", with the explanation, "The practice card passed on its saved Retro pick." Local Git history does not match that attribution. This retro records the practice result as supplied, not as independently verified delivery evidence. The duration and review-round metric is only "practice".

## 1. Medium: the practice brief points at a different landed change

`git show -s --format='%H%n%s' 8da32d3` resolves to
`8da32d352c678aa63f560b784fd0c290ed76a879`, titled
`fix(dashboard): read the picker's models file on every run (JUL-345) (#467)`.
`git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-only -r 8da32d3 -- machine/merge/retro.mjs`
returns no paths. The commit is an ancestor of this checkout's HEAD, but it does not substantiate the brief's PR number or touched-file claim. The supplied PASS text alone does not establish which model answered or that the saved Retro pick was used.

Check: before constructing a retro task, compare the supplied card, pull request, merge commit, and changed-file list with the merge record and Git diff. Reject a mismatch before presenting those fields as landed facts. A claim about the answering model also needs the run's trace, which this brief does not supply.

Status: open. The local Git checks above exposed this mismatch during this retro. No automated attribution check was built or tested here.
